4.en: ‘It is my destiny to find the God-Emperor’s next vessel, a task passed down from Thorian to Thorian, from my mentor to me. My duty is to herd the psykers of the sector and cull the impure from them, find the best among them and train them to be better. Holy Terra awaits.’

50.en: Seek out pure psykers across the sector.

58.en: Hunt rogue psykers and heretical cults.

66.en: Train psykers to bolster the Inquisition’s strength.

78.en: As a member of the Ordo Hereticus, Inquisitor @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.B0kjmCWM6na30YqG]{Ksenia Baek} has carved herself a reputation within the Macharian Inquisition as the sector’s foremost expert on psykers and witchcraft. Her work has kept her close to the goals of her Thorian philosophy — to seek out a pure psychic avatar for the God-Emperor to inhabit upon his eventual return. Ksenia chases psykers across the sector to seek out this prophesied avatar, spurred by reported miracles and psychic divinations.

82.en: The now deceased Inquisitor Onderghast identified Baek’s psychic abilities in her early childhood, during an investigation of a xenos cult on her home agri world of Rauss V. Onderghast noted the child emitting an unnerving psychic presence, disrupting his connection to the Empyrean. Through training and mentorship, he instilled within her the tenets of the Thorian philosophy — believing for some time that she might become the God-Emperor’s new avatar. But through extensive testing and trials, Onderghast eventually deemed her not pure enough. Instead, it was Baek’s destiny to succeed him and take up his task.

86.en: Baek brokered a deal with the League of Black Ships, aiding them in investigating and capturing problematic psykers in return for a base of operations aboard one of their voidships. On

90.en: , Inquisitor @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.B0kjmCWM6na30YqG]{Ksenia Baek} has overseen the training of hundreds of Inquisitorial acolytes and fledgeling psykers. Baek has long worked alongside the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.upGG1JZPDbC7dpJJ]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica}, her investigations generating a wellspring of psykers. Many are loaded aboard the Black Ships as part of their damned cargo, but a select few go on to serve the Inquisitor, sometimes bypassing their sanctioning when Baek sees fit, and installed within her acolyte cells across the sector.

104.en: Baek is sure that an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.cKepLkmLocC4tuPy]{Ocularian} Inquisitor from the Calixis Sector is secretly operating in the Macharian Sector, collecting information to fuel their grand divinations. She believes the collective information and prophecies the Ocularians have made can guide her to the destined avatar she has spent most of her life looking for — she is also curious to see what divinations they hold about herself.

108.en: Baek’s closeness to the League of Black Ships works towards the culmination of her plans. Once she has secured the God-Emperor’s avatar, she plans to commandeer

112.en: or whatever Black Ship is nearest (by force if necessary) and make haste for Terra — dropping whatever Inquisitorial investigations she is in the middle of. Though the chance of this happening is improbable, her hopes rest on a personal divination she received in her early years of training from Onderghast — a vision he saw of her aboard a Black Ship back to Holy Terra. Perhaps naively, Baek interprets this divination positively rather than as a sign of future damnation.

116.en: Psykers in the presence of Baek and her acolytes have been known to experience a similar, disquieting phenomenon to that reported by Inquisitor Onderghast. Baek is afraid to pick at this psychic scab within her soul, fearful it will confirm her impurity. Regardless of her intentions, every expression of Baek’s considerable psychic might is deeply unsettling to non-blanks in her vicinity. Most are left with recurring nightmares for days or experience waking visions of death — usually their own.

120.en: This is because the Inquisitor has a shadow, a Daemon calling itself Baek. It has haunted her since childhood, confined to the Warp but always nearby. Time in the Warp is fluid, ebbing and flowing as it wills, frequently turning back upon itself. Baek keeps the Inquisitor close because it knows that she will one day be responsible for its own creation. If he became aware of the unusual aura she projects, @UUID[.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} would be interested in studying her.
